fields.title: Kōgyō Shisetsu Hoshu Unei Hōkoku
fields.subject: Shisetsu hoshu ni kansuru minsei to gunji no meirei fuguai

operations.production: Meirei fuguai ni yori itiji teishi

findings: Gunji kanri bu to minsei kōgyō bu no meirei ga kyōgō shi, sagyō-in ni kontoran o hikiokoshita.
Kobayashi Isamu shi no shiji chōsei no yōsei wa jigyō keiei jō kinkyū de aru.

financial.status: Chōsei sagyō no tame no yosan tsuika hitsuyō
financial.notes: Fukusō meirei no kaisū ni yori hassei shita teitai sonshitsu.

recommendations: Meirei no tōgō to kōgyō hoshu keikaku no saihankō o jisshi suru koto.

claims.fact: Kaisha hōkoku wa futatsu no bukyoku kara no fukusō meirei ga sagyō ni shōgai o kitashita koto o mitomete iru.
